title: Backport golang-1.24 1.24.13-2 (resolute) to this release.
description:
Backport golang-1.24 1.24.13-2 (resolute) to this release.

Fixes 22 CVEs plus the crypto/x509 fix in 1.24.9. SRU bug: LP: #2164608.

Changelog entry on top of ubuntu/devel (1.24.13-2) plus the standard
Ubuntu maintainer switch in debian/control{,.in}, matching the previous
golang-1.24 backport (LP: #2103780).
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index d100d6b..21343a3 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,9 @@
+golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2~22.04.1) jammy; urgency=medium
+
+  * Backport to Jammy (LP: #2164608)
+
+ -- Anshul Singh <anshul.singh@canonical.com>  Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:04:39 +0530
+
 golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2) unstable; urgency=medium
 
   * Team upload.
